instruction: 針對 產線 1 的資料流，使用 qc_check.sh 監控 陶瓷片 門檻 0.75 並通知 dashboard。
請從 batch-queue 擷取 壓克力面板 狀態，透過 report-svc 轉換欄位名稱後寫入 archive-bucket。
output: {"steps":[{"nodeId":"node-4","tool":"report-svc","script":"report.sh","args":{"input":"batch-queue","output":"archive-bucket","fieldMapping":{"原欄位名稱":"新欄位名稱"},"filter":"壓克力面板"}}],"supervisorPolicy":"fail-fast"}

instruction: 請在 node-1 上把 不鏽鋼管 測量值轉換為 XLSX，忽略低於 95 的紀錄。
將 玻璃基板 的品檢資料以 PDF 封存，來源 產線 1，封存目的地 manual-review。
output: {"steps":[{"nodeId":"node-1","tool":"切割機","script":"cut.sh","args":{"material":"玻璃基板","line":"產線 1"}},{"nodeId":"node-3","tool":"品質檢測儀","script":"qc_check.sh","args":{"material":"玻璃基板","line":"產線 1"}},{"nodeId":"node-4","tool":"report-svc","script":"report.sh","args":{"data":"品檢資料","format":"PDF","destination":"manual-review"}},{"nodeId":"node-5","tool":"搬運車","script":"transfer.sh","args":{"source":"產線 1","destination":"manual-review"}}],"supervisorPolicy":"fail-fast"}

instruction: 請把 碳纖維片 的測試結果合併成 HTML，來源 產線 1，目的地 產線 2。
output: {"steps":[{"nodeId":"node-1","tool":"切割機","script":"cut.sh","args":{"material":"碳纖維片","source":"產線 1"}},{"nodeId":"node-2","tool":"CNC-03","script":"cnc_job.sh","args":{"material":"碳纖維片","source":"產線 1"}},{"nodeId":"node-3","tool":"品質檢測儀","script":"qc_check.sh","args":{"material":"碳纖維片","source":"產線 1"}},{"nodeId":"node-4","tool":"report-svc","script":"report.sh","args":{"material":"碳纖維片","source":"產線 1","destination":"產線 2","format":"HTML"}},{"nodeId":"node-5","tool":"搬運車","script":"transfer.sh","args":{"material":"碳纖維片","source":"產線 1","destination":"產線 2"}}],"supervisorPolicy":"fail-fast"}

instruction: 安排流程將 倉庫 A 的 玻璃基板 批號標準化，數量 20，再寫到 report-service。

instruction: 安排節點 node-3 對 100 個 矽晶圓 樣本進行分類，低於 0.75 的送人工複核。
